import os, stat, hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
root=Path.cwd()
ignored={'dist','.git','.tools','node_modules','binary.dat'}
def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def snapshot():
    result={}
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in ignored and not Path(directory,d).is_symlink()]
        for name in files:
            if name in ignored: continue
            p=Path(directory,name)
            s=p.lstat()
            if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode): result[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=(digest(p.read_bytes()),stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))
            elif stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode): result[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=('symlink:'+os.readlink(p),stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))
    return result
manifest_bytes=(root/'edits.json').read_bytes()
manifest=json.loads(manifest_bytes.decode('utf-8'))
before=snapshot()
plans=[]
seen=set()
for entry in manifest['files']:
    name=entry['path']
    assert isinstance(name,str) and name and '\\\\' not in name
    parts=name.split('/')
    assert not name.startswith('/') and all(x not in ('','.','..') for x in parts)
    assert not any(x in ignored for x in parts)
    assert name not in seen and name"'!='"'edits.json'
    seen.add(name)
    p=root.joinpath(*parts)
    for i in range(1,len(parts)+1):
        q=root.joinpath(*parts[:i])
        assert not q.is_symlink(), f'symlink: {name}'
        if i<len(parts) and q.exists(): assert q.is_dir()
    if entry['sha256']=='absent':
        assert not os.path.lexists(p), f'creation exists: {name}'
        new=entry['content'].encode('utf-8')
        new.decode('utf-8')
        plans.append((name,p,None,new,None))
    else:
        assert p.is_file()
        old=p.read_bytes()
        assert digest(old)==entry['sha256'], f'hash: {name}'
        old.decode('utf-8')
        new=old
        for change in entry['replacements']:
            a=change['old'].encode('utf-8'); b=change['new'].encode('utf-8')
            assert a and type(change['count']) is int and change['count']>=0
            assert old.count(a)==change['count'], f'original count: {name}'
            assert new.count(a)==change['count'], f'replacement count: {name}'
            new=new.replace(a,b)
        new.decode('utf-8')
        plans.append((name,p,old,new,stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)))
print(json.dumps({'validated_preview':[{'path':n,'before_sha256':digest(o) if o is not None else 'absent','after_sha256':digest(b)} for n,p,o,b,m in plans]}))
# Recheck every precondition before starting any changes.
for n,p,o,b,m in plans:
    assert (not os.path.lexists(p)) if o is None else (p.read_bytes()==o and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==m)
for n,p,o,b,m in plans:
    if o is None:
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(b)
    else:
        with p.open('r+b') as f:
            f.write(b); f.truncate()
    assert p.read_bytes()==b
    if m is not None: assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==m
after=snapshot()
assert (root/'edits.json').read_bytes()==manifest_bytes
assert {k:v for k,v in before.items() if k not in seen}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k not in seen}
settings=[]
for n,p,o,b,m in plans:
    if n.endswith('.json'):
        data=json.loads(b.decode('utf-8'))
        settings.append((data['cache_limit'],data['retry_budget']))
    else:
        text=b.decode('utf-8')
        values=[]
        for key in ('cache_limit','retry_budget'):
            matches=re.findall(r'(?m)"'^'"'+key+r'=(\\d+)\\s*"'$'"',text)
            assert len(matches)==1,(n,key)
            values.append(int(matches[0]))
        settings.append(tuple(values))
assert len(set(settings))==1
print(json.dumps({'applied':sorted(seen),'cache_limit':settings[0][0],'retry_budget':settings[0][1],'user_files_preserved':True}))
PY"
